column1: The simulated dataset contains 1,500 shipments across five regions and four transport modes.
Average actual delivery time is 5.59 days and the median is 5.35 days.
The overall simulated delivery delay rate is 9.3%.
Average transportation cost is 247.72, with total simulated transportation cost of 371,580.62.
Distance and transportation cost have a correlation of 0.67, indicating that longer routes are an important cost driver.
Shipment volume and transportation cost have a correlation of 0.44, showing that heavier shipments tend to increase logistics cost.
Road has the highest simulated delay rate at 10.0% among the transport modes.
